'''Dinesh Lal Yadav''' (born 2 February 1979), popularly known as '''Nirahua''', is an Indian actor, singer, producer and politician who works in [[Bhojpuri language|Bhojpuri]]-language films. He is among the most successful Bhojpuri actors, with several consecutive box-office successes in 2015.<ref>{{cite news |title=Dinesh Lal Yadav's new record |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/Dinesh-Lal-Yadavs-new-record/articleshow/49890847.cms |date=23 November 2015 |newspaper=[[The Times of India]] |access-date=29 February 2016 |archive-date=2 April 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160402175350/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/Dinesh-Lal-Yadavs-new-record/articleshow/49890847.cms |url-status=live }}</ref> He owns the production house ''Nirahua Entertainment Pvt Ltd.'' Dinesh Lal Yadav was a contestant on ''[[Bigg Boss (Hindi season 6)|Bigg Boss 6]]'' in 2012.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|url=http://www.rediff.com/movies/slide-show/slide-show-1-nobody-is-big-or-small-in-bigg-boss-tv/20121015.htm|title=Nobody is big or small in Bigg Boss. Everybody is equal|access-date=16 November 2017|archive-date=2 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190402100822/https://www.rediff.com/movies/slide-show/slide-show-1-nobody-is-big-or-small-in-bigg-boss-tv/20121015.htm|url-status=live}}</ref>

Nirahua was a member of parliament from [[Azamgarh Lok Sabha constituency]] as a member of the [[Bharatiya Janata Party]] from 2022 till 2024. Coming from a family of traditional [[Biraha]] singers of [[Ghazipur]], he began his career as a folk singer with the album ''Nirahua Satal Rahe'' (2003), which became a major hit and earned him the stage name "Nirahua". He made his film debut in the Bhojpuri drama ''Humka Aisa Waisa Na Samjha'' (2006) and gained wider fame with ''Chalat Mushafir Moh Liyo Re'' (2006), ''Nirahua Rikshaw Wala'' (2008) and ''[[Pratigya (2008 film)|Pratigya]]'' (2008).<ref>{{Cite web|title=भोजपुरी जुबली स्टार दिनेश लाल यादव निरहुआ की स्टोरी किसी फ़िल्म से कम नहीं|url=https://www.ichowk.in/cinema/bhojpuri-film-actor-singer-producer-dinesh-lal-yadav-nirahua-biography-nirahua-films-nirahua-songs-bhojpuri-star-nirahua-life-and-family/story/1/18275.html|access-date=2021-11-19|website=www.ichowk.in|language=hindi}}</ref>

In 2012, he appeared with [[Amitabh Bachchan]] and [[Jaya Bachchan]] in ''Ganga Devi'' and also participated in ''Bigg Boss 6'' that year.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-10-22|title=Bhojpuri movies that made the headline|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/bhojpuri-movies-that-made-the-headline/photostory/87099253.cms|access-date=2021-11-19|website=The Times of India|language=en}}</ref> His fiftieth film, ''[[Nirahua Hindustani]]'' (2014), was a commercial success that reached multiplex audiences.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Nirahua Hindustani reaches multiplex – Times of India|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/nirahua-hindustani-reaches-multiplex/articleshow/43990516.cms|access-date=2021-11-19|website=The Times of India|language=en}}</ref> He later starred in patriotic films such as ''[[Patna Se Pakistan]]'' (2015) and ''[[Border (2018 Bhojpuri film)|Border]]'' (2018), two of the highest-grossing Bhojpuri films. His ''Nirahua Chalal London'' (2019) was shot in London, and in 2019 he made his [[Over-the-top media service|OTT]] debut in the Bhojpuri web series ''[[Hero Vardiwala]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=ALTBalaji all set to foray into Bhojpuri originals space with 'Hero Vardiwala'|url=https://www.mumbailive.com/en/digital/altbalaji-to-foray-into-bhojpuri-originals-space-with-dinesh-lal-yadav-nirahua-hero-vardiwala-32127|access-date=2021-11-19|website=Mumbai Live|language=en}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Nirahua was born to Kumar Yadav and Chandrajyoti Yadav. He has a brother, Pravesh Lal Yadav, and a sister, Lalita Yadav.

He spent most of his childhood days in "Belghoria" at 4 no. railway gate (Agarpara) area of [[Kolkata]] where his father worked in a factory. He completed his education in the same suburbs of [[Kolkata]].

He comes from a family of famous [[Biraha]] folk singers hailing from [[Ghazipur]]. Famous Biraha singer Vijay Lal Yadav known as "Biraha Samrat" and writer and lyricist Pyare Lal Yadav (Kaviji) who has penned many songs in [[Bhojpuri cinema]], are his first cousins. {{Citation needed|date=April 2026}}

== Acting career ==

=== Early hits and establishment (2006–2011) ===
He started his acting career with the Bhojpuri film ''[[Humka Aisa Waisa Na Samjha]]'' (Don't think that I'm riff-raff) in 2006 in which he played the role of a boy who fights to make [[Bhojpuri language|Bhojpuri]] a recognised language in the state. But his first released movie was ''Chalat Musafir Moh Liyo Re'' (The traveller has been ensnared) in which he played the supporting role of a police inspector with [[Kalpana Patowary]] and Sunil Chhaila Bihari. His third film was ''Ho Gail Ba Pyar Odhaniya Waali Se'' (I have fallen in love with a girl wearing stole, 2007). After this film, he received many offers. His next film ''Nirahua Rikshawala'' (2007) became a super hit. After the success of his another film titled ''Kahan Jaiba Raja Najariya Ladaike'' (2007), he was an established actor in the industry and had got the title "Jublee Star". His another hit movie in 2008 was ''Lagal Raha Ae Rajaji''. His natural acting style, slim body unlike other Bhojpuri actor those days, and action moves due to his Karate training in his childhood, made him so popular among the audience that even his flop films used to run over three weeks. He also did stage shows in Fiji, Australia and New Zealand in 2007.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Ghosh|first=Avijit|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=wAuTZ6_1XL4C&dq=nirahua+rickshawala&pg=PT126|title=CINEMA BHOJPURI|date=2010-05-22|publisher=Penguin UK|isbn=978-81-8475-256-4|language=en}}</ref>

He continued giving hits likes [[Pratigya (2008 film)|''Pratigya'']] (2008), ''Pariwaar'' (2008), ''Nirahua No. 1'' (2009), [[Saat Saheliyan]] (2010), ''Nirahua Chalal Sasural'' (2011). In a review of his film ''Aulaad'' (2011), ''[[Times of India]]'' wrote that "Dinesh Lal Yadav has live up his role".<ref>{{Citation|title=Aulaad Movie Review {3/5}: Critic Review of Aulaad by Times of India|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movie-reviews/aulaad/movie-review/14689481.cms|access-date=2021-11-30}}</ref>

=== TV debut and high budget films (2012–2018) ===
In 2012, he appeared in the ''[[Bigg Boss]]'' as a contestant. His film ''Ganga Jamuna Saraswati'' (2012) earned 12.5 million in just three weeks which highest by any Bhojpuri movie in those times.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ganga Jamuna Saraswati makes a record – Times of India|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/ganga-jamuna-saraswati-makes-a-record/articleshow/19555606.cms|access-date=2021-11-30|website=The Times of India|language=en}}</ref> He acted with [[Amitabh Bachchan]], [[Jaya Bachchan]] and [[Gulshan Grover]] in the Bhojpuri film ''Ganga Devi'' (2012).<ref>{{Cite news|title=Big B, Jaya in Ganga Devi|work=[[The Times of India]]|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/big-b-jaya-in-ganga-devi/articleshow/15530537.cms}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2012-09-01|title=Big B conscious of Jaya's presence on sets of 'Ganga Devi'|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/entertainment-others/big-b-conscious-of-jayas-presence-on-sets-of-ganga-devi/|access-date=2021-11-30|website=The Indian Express|language=en}}</ref> His fiftieth project ''[[Nirahua Hindustani]]'' (2014) reached multiplexes.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Nirahua Hindustani reaches multiplex – Times of India|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/nirahua-hindustani-reaches-multiplex/articleshow/43990516.cms|access-date=2021-11-30|website=The Times of India|language=en}}</ref> Another of his hit movies was [[Patna Se Pakistan]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Nirahua back with 'Patna Se Pakistan' – Times of India|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/nirahua-back-with-patna-se-pakistan/articleshow/46356370.cms|access-date=2021-11-30|website=The Times of India|language=en}}</ref> In 2016, he received Uttar Pradesh's highest civilian award "Yash Bharti Samman Award" by the Uttar Pradesh Government for this contribution in Bhojpuri films.

''[[Bam Bam Bol Raha Hai Kashi]]'' (2016) was produced by [[Priyanka Chopra]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Priyanka Chopra's first Bhojpuri movie getting ready for release – Times of India ►|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bhojpuri/movies/news/priyanka-chopras-first-bhojpuri-movie-getting-ready-for-release/articleshow/51937562.cms|access-date=2021-11-30|website=The Times of India|language=en}}</ref> [[Nirahua Hindustani 2]] won eleven awards at [[Sabrang Film Awards]]. His ''Kashi Amarnath'' (2018) was another movie that was produced by [[Priyanka Chopra]]. Grossing 190 million, his patriotic film [[Border (2018 Bhojpuri film)|Border]] (2018) is one of the highest earning Bhojpuri films ever.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Hindi News: Latest News in Hindi, हिन्दी न्यूज़, Breaking News, लेटेस्ट हिंदी न्यूज़, Hindi Khabar, हिंदी खबरें, ब्रेकिंग न्यूज़ {{!}} Navbharat Times|url=https://navbharattimes.indiatimes.com/|access-date=2021-11-30|website=Navbharat Times|language=hi}}</ref>

=== OTT debut and other films (2019–present) ===
In made his OTT debut in 2019 with ''[[Hero Vardiwala]]'', which was the first webseries ever made in Bhojpuri language.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2018-05-16|title=Dinesh Lal Yadav and Amrapali Dubey in first ever Bhojpuri web-series – All you need to know|url=https://zeenews.india.com/bhojpuri/dinesh-lal-yadav-and-amrapali-dubey-in-first-ever-bhojpuri-web-series-all-you-need-to-know-2108608.html|access-date=2021-11-30|website=Zee News|language=en}}</ref> He released his first short film ''Kukkur'' in 2021 which was based on the plight of elderly people in old-age homes.<ref name=":1" /> On 10 December 2021, his film ''Hum Hain Dulha Hindustani'' released, which was a [[Romantic comedy]] film starring [[Amrapali Dubey]] and [[Madhu Sharma]]. This was Nirahua's second film that was shot in London after [[Nirahua Chalal London]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=दिनेश लाल यादव 'निरहुआ' की 'हम हैं दूल्हा हिंदुस्तानी' का टीजर आउट, आम्रपाली दूबे संग कर रहे रोमांस|url=https://www.jagran.com/entertainment/bollywood-bhojpuri-actor-dinesh-lal-yadav-nirhua-and-amrapali-dubey-film-hum-hain-dulha-hindustani-teaser-out-22281601.html|access-date=2021-12-14|website=Dainik Jagran|language=hi}}</ref> On 1 January 2022, he released his next short film ''Dahar''. He played the role of a [[Launda Naach|Launda]] in his next film "Naach Baiju Naach" which was released in September.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Bhojpuri Film: भिखारी ठाकुर के 'लौंडा नाच' पर बना निरहुआ का फिल्म 'नाच बैजू नाच' कल होगी रिलीज, देखें |url=https://www.prabhatkhabar.com/state/bihar/patna/bhojpuri-film-nirhua-film-nach-baiju-naach-based-on-bhikhari-thakur-launda-naach-released-skm |access-date=2022-09-23 |website=Prabhat Khabar |language=hi}}</ref>

== Political career ==
Nirahua joined politics by becoming a member of the [[Bharatiya Janata Party]] in [[Lucknow]] on 27 March 2019 in presence of Uttar Pradesh chief minister [[Yogi Adityanath]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/bhojpuri-actor-dinesh-lal-yadav-nirhua-joins-bjp-2013612?&tb_cb=1|title=Bhojpuri Actor Dinesh Lal Yadav Joins BJP|date=27 March 2019|publisher=NDTV|access-date=27 March 2019|archive-date=27 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190327135209/https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/bhojpuri-actor-dinesh-lal-yadav-nirhua-joins-bjp-2013612?&tb_cb=1|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://abpnews.abplive.in/bollywood/lok-sabha-election-2019bhojpuri-stars-ravi-kishan-and-dinesh-lal-yadav-joins-bjp-1096095|title=लोकसभा चुनाव 2019: चुनावी अखाड़े में कूदे निरहुआ और रवि किशन, चुनावों में चढ़ेगा भोजपुरी रंग|date=27 March 2019|work=[[ABP News]]|access-date=27 March 2019|archive-date=27 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190327131857/https://abpnews.abplive.in/bollywood/lok-sabha-election-2019bhojpuri-stars-ravi-kishan-and-dinesh-lal-yadav-joins-bjp-1096095|url-status=dead}}</ref> On 3 April 2019 he was declared a candidate to contest the 2019 Indian Lok Sabha election from [[Azamgarh (Lok Sabha constituency)|Azamgarh constituency]] from [[Bharatiya Janata Party]]. He unsuccessfully faced [[Akhilesh Yadav]], [[List of chief ministers of Uttar Pradesh|the former chief minister of Uttar Pradesh]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.jagran.com/politics/national-bjp-releases-16th-list-of-6-candidates-dinesh-lal-yadav-to-contest-from-azamgarh-against-akhilesh-yadav-19098939.html|title=भाजपा ने जारी की उम्‍मीदवारों की 16वीं लिस्‍ट, अखिलेश के खिलाफ ताल ठोकेंगे दिनेश लाल यादव उर्फ निरहुआ|date=3 April 2019|work=Jagran|access-date=7 April 2019|language=Hindi|archive-date=6 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190406091828/https://m.jagran.com/politics/national-bjp-releases-16th-list-of-6-candidates-dinesh-lal-yadav-to-contest-from-azamgarh-against-akhilesh-yadav-19098939.html|url-status=live}}</ref> He lost against Akhilesh Yadav by a margin of 259,874 votes.

In 2022 bypolls from [[Azamgarh (Lok Sabha constituency)|Azamgarh constituency]], he defeated [[Samajwadi Party]] candidate [[Dharmendra Yadav]] by a margin of 8,700 votes.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bhojpuri superstar to politician: Know about Dinesh Lal Yadav 'Nirhua' who defeated SP's Dharmendra Yadav in bypolls |url=https://www.dnaindia.com/india/report-bhojpuri-superstar-to-politician-know-about-dinesh-lal-yadav-nirhua-who-defeated-sp-dharmendra-yadav-in-bypoll-2963831 |access-date=2022-06-29 |website=DNA India |language=en}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
He married Mansha Yadav in the year 2000. The couple has two sons, Aditya Yadav, Amit Yadav and one daughter, Aditi Yadav.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://hindi.news18.com/news/entertainment/bhojpuri-dinesh-lal-yadav-nirahua-daughter-aditi-yadav-boxing-video-gone-viral-raya-3766425.html|title=बॉक्सर है Dinesh lal yadav Nirahua की बेटी! नहीं हो रहा यकीन तो देख लें उसका viral video}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.aajtak.in/entertainment/bhojpuri/story/amrapali-dubey-shower-her-love-on-nirahua-s-son-aditya-yadav-birthday-bhojpuri-star-tmovb-1582472-2022-11-24#:~:text=%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%B9%E0%A5%81%E0%A4%86%20%E0%A4%95%E0%A5%87%20%E0%A4%AC%E0%A5%87%E0%A4%9F%E0%A5%87%20%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AF%20%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%B5,%E0%A4%B8%E0%A5%80%20%E0%A4%AB%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%9F%E0%A5%8B%20%E0%A4%AA%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%B8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%9F%20%E0%A4%95%E0%A5%80%20%E0%A4%B9%E0%A5%88.|title=निरहुआ के बेटे को आम्रपाली ने दी बर्थडे की बधाई, फिर होने लगी अफेयर की चर्चा}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.abplive.com/photo-gallery/entertainment/bhojpuri-cinema-bhojpuri-star-dinesh-lala-yadav-aka-nirahua-wife-mansha-devi-and-their-children-actor-affair-rumours-with-amrapali-dubey-2554119|title=Bhojpuri: हमेशा आम्रपाली संग दिखने वाले Nirahua की असली बीवी को जानते हैं आप? तीन बच्चों के बाप हैं ये भोजपुरी एक्टर}}</ref>

Yadav is also rumoured to be simultaneously married to co-actor [[Amrapali Dubey]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=निरहुआ के साथ ही फिल्में क्यों करती हैं आम्रपाली, खुद बताई थी वजह |url=https://www.jansatta.com/photos/entertainment-gallery/nirahua-amrapali-dubey-rumoured-affair-this-is-why-bhojpuri-actress-did-movies-only-with-bjp-mp-dinesh-lal-yadav/2249264/ |access-date=2023-02-03 |website=Jansatta |language=hi}}</ref>

=== Controversy ===
In 2025, he criticized fellow Bhojpuri actor [[Khesari Lal Yadav]],<ref>{{Cite web |last=तक |first=यूपी |last2=UPTAK |date=2025-11-04 |title=नचनिया वाली बात सुन निरहुआ ने खेसारी यादव को कहा यदुमुल्ला, फिर पवन सिंह बोले- तो क्या गलती है इसमें |url=https://www.uptak.in/bhojpuri-cinema/story/hearing-about-the-dancer-nirahua-called-khesari-yadav-yadumulla-then-pawan-singh-said-so-what-is-wrong-in-this-3212400-2025-11-04 |access-date=2025-11-05 |website=UP Tak |language=hi}}</ref> over remarks regarding the [[Ram Mandir]], referring to him as "'''Yadumulla'''", which sparked controversy over caste and communal remarks.<ref name="ET2025">{{cite web |date=2025 |title=He's not Yadav, he's Yadumulla: Nirahua slams Khesari Lal over Ram Mandir remark in Bihar poll heat |url=https://m.economictimes.com/news/elections/assembly-elections/bihar/hes-not-yadav-hes-yadumullah-nirahua-slams-khesari-lal-over-ram-mandir-remark-in-bihar-poll-heat/videoshow/125083648.cms |access-date=5 November 2025 |website=Economic Times}}</ref> He further claimed, as reported by ''[[The Economic Times]]'', "true Yadavs proudly stand with [[Lord Ram]] and the [[National Democratic Alliance|NDA]]'s development agenda".<ref name="ET2025" />

extract:
Dinesh Lal Yadav (born 2 February 1979), popularly known as Nirahua, is an Indian actor, singer, producer and politician who works in Bhojpuri-language films. He is among the most successful Bhojpuri actors, with several consecutive box-office successes in 2015. He owns the production house Nirahua Entertainment Pvt Ltd. Dinesh Lal Yadav was a contestant on Bigg Boss 6 in 2012.
Nirahua was a member of parliament from Azamgarh Lok Sabha constituency as a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party from 2022 till 2024. Coming from a family of traditional Biraha singers of Ghazipur, he began his career as a folk singer with the album Nirahua Satal Rahe (2003), which became a major hit and earned him the stage name "Nirahua". He made his film debut in the Bhojpuri drama Humka Aisa Waisa Na Samjha (2006) and gained wider fame with Chalat Mushafir Moh Liyo Re (2006), Nirahua Rikshaw Wala (2008) and Pratigya (2008).
In 2012, he appeared with Amitabh Bachchan and Jaya Bachchan in Ganga Devi and also participated in Bigg Boss 6 that year. His fiftieth film, Nirahua Hindustani (2014), was a commercial success that reached multiplex audiences. He later starred in patriotic films such as Patna Se Pakistan (2015) and Border (2018), two of the highest-grossing Bhojpuri films. His Nirahua Chalal London (2019) was shot in London, and in 2019 he made his OTT debut in the Bhojpuri web series Hero Vardiwala.
